issues.description: The script uses GM_xmlhttpRequest to communicate with sponsor.ajay.app (SponsorBlock API) and evdfrance.fr (video download). These are third-party servers. However, only video IDs and category data are sent, not sensitive user data or cookies.
issues.recommendation: Review the endpoints' privacy policies and ensure only minimal, non-sensitive data is sent. Consider warning users about third-party API usage.

issues.description: The script requests GM_xmlhttpRequest permission, which allows arbitrary cross-origin requests. However, usage is limited to the two whitelisted domains.
issues.recommendation: Limit @connect domains strictly and document all external requests in user documentation.

issues.description: The script stores and retrieves user settings using GM_setValue and GM_getValue. No sensitive data is stored, only feature toggles.
